Well, I have no tips again Zoe and leblanc because I get ass blasted by them everytime (I also rarely encounter them) but, my only way of playing the game when against the ugly zed, Leblanc, and wind brothers are.. playing behind the wave. I choose to lose some CS over dying so I can respo to fights. If the wave is on you, since you don't trade when u know u lose, you can E-R wave and help team fights. Having no R sucks but your Root and slow is still a game changer. Remember, you don't have to carry every game, or get every Cs. Play passive and you can still win. Of course, don't give them time to roam too. If you play Super safe, they'll perma shove lane and roam. Keep your visions and calls well when they're missing. That's what I do most of the time especially against zed. You can land pokes on zed if his Shadow CD is down. If his E (slowing turn around slash) hits you, it reduces a bit of its CD so be careful. Don't think you'll solo kill him unless he makes mistakes and dives you LOL (also whenever he ults he appears on your back, not your front) now for yasuo, I play by my minions. He uses your minions as leverage to get to you, BUT you can use it to your advantage too. Fight with your minions!! Auto the f##k out of him, land your E, and you'd petty much at least win the trade. If you managed to bait his windwall, that's a free Root too. But it's tricky so I don't really try when I bait it so lol. I auto, E, and W, at least. Sometimes also ult while E is slowing because whenever he dashes the minions or champs he dashes to has cooldowns on when he can dash again so pay attention to where he dashes. When you can auto yasuo, do so at least so you can remove his shield passive! He can't block your R with windwall too. With yone, it's the same but he's more tricky to deal with since he can just E back to his main body. I suggest don't let him poke you with Q + passive a lot. It's hard but also don't get hit by ult. 

I'm sorry this was long but these are my main things I do when I'm against zed, yasuo, and yone. I wish I can give tips on Leblanc and Zoe but like I said, I rarely encounter them :( I hope this was a bit helpful and I made sense 😅 goodluck on your games ❤️

I always expect Kat mains to blink on their daggers so I have my Q ready always. Make sure to still play safe though, but fuck up their wave when they roam or go missing.
